answer: A new identity starts with nothing. Reputation builds slowly, one good trade at a time. Faking a thousand fresh accounts gets you a thousand zeros. There is no shortcut to trust. Old reputation also fades if you go quiet. An idle account loses weight. So a sybil farm can't stockpile credibility and sit on it. It has to keep proving itself, and that costs real work. A fake identity is just a mirror of trust, not trust itself. It casts no echo in the market. Real standing builds like a dune, grain by grain, and the wind takes it back when you stop.
